mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL over the prior 3 months signals deflationary expectations and imminent monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to compressed discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates severe labor market distress causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 3 months reflects weakening consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (GDPC1 contraction), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals deteriorating economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines during a recession (GDPC1 contraction).

mechanism_narrative: A rising PAYEMS (employment growth) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 20-day returns through increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it reflects restrictive monetary policy causing negative S&P 500 5-day returns due to reduced liquidity and investment activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates broad-based economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 300), a rising CPIAUCSL signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns due to reduced real cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300 and rising.
